prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: could I please have an email address/web link to make an overall complaint about lost baggage/broken luggage & poor customer service
Delta: My apologies for teh issues that happen. Here is a link below to make a complaint to that department. Thank you. ... 1/2

Customer: Over 50 days later still no word on my lost baggage compensation?
Delta: ...apologies for the delay.  *HRO 2/2

Customer: failed the baggage delivery promise on #518.  I will take points and then some!
Delta: ...https://t.co/9qP7jNm0t7 *HCA 2/2

Customer: your customer service is appalling. Been waiting 3 months for you to give us our refund from  sort it out!
Delta: Yikes! That's not what we like to hear. How may I assist you via this channel? *ATJ

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: baggage):
"""3 months now, lost baggage, all receipts sent in and still no recompense or customer service..at all. Every promise broken"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry you’ve had to wait. Please DM us your reservation number and contact info so we can look into your baggage claim right away. Thank you.
